name: Gargantuar
visualObservations: Hunched giant; red collar and brown vest; torn dark trousers, brown boots; basket with red-shirt Imp; telephone pole.
decision: Actual-game redraw approved by user. Preserve approved design.

name: Sphinx-inator
visualObservations: One enormous yellow eye within a gold pharaoh fan body; four articulated pointed legs; huge-cranium scientist pilot above eye.
decision: Actual-game redraw approved by user. Cat body, paws and tail discarded.

name: Plank Walker
visualObservations: Single yellow bow eye; tall wooden hull; four anchor-foot walking legs; torn sail; eyepatched pilot; pirate tied to bowsprit.

name: Frost Mammoth / Tuskmaster 10,000 BC
visualObservations: Floating shaggy brown mammoth head; long curling trunk, bound ivory tusks, angry yellow eyes, fur-framed cockpit.
decision: Replace blue elephant robot draft; retain project ID frostmammoth.

name: Dark Dragon
visualObservations: Elongated olive armored dragon; yellow eyes; angular silver nose ring; spiked segmented body; knight-armored pilot with red plume.
decision: Purple winged pet and heart tail explicitly rejected by user.

name: Tomorrow-tron
visualObservations: Olive riveted pod; huge single yellow eye and steel teeth; orange-red joints; six pointed spider legs; cyan dome with scientist pilot.
decision: White astronaut with arm cannon explicitly rejected by user.

name: War Wagon
visualObservations: Tall timber body with huge single yellow eye; spoked wheels on walking struts; open railed roof, scientist pilot and large bull at rear.
decision: Covered cowboy wagon explicitly rejected by user.

name: Aerostatic Gondola
visualObservations: Ornate wooden flying hull; golden skull bow; vines, hanging sacks; round side propellers, cream tailwing; aviator-goggle pilot; purple ribbed burner above.
decision: Striped balloon with eyes explicitly rejected by user. Match visible PvZ2 ship. Upper balloon can be outside game viewport; do not invent a face on it.

name: Sharktronic Sub
visualObservations: Angular silver shark jaw; huge triangular metal teeth; yellow eye, rivets, fins; rear glass dome scientist pilot.

name: Dinotronic Mechasaur
visualObservations: Long silver/lavender segmented dinosaur head and neck; squared hinged jaw and block teeth; yellow eye, rivets; small top cockpit.
decision: Fresh actual-game redraw; avoid invented baby dinosaur legs.

name: Multi-stage Masher
visualObservations: Punk mode concert stage with stacked loudspeakers, teal drums, brass cymbals, mohawked pilot, guitar/keytar zombie bandmates.
decision: Use recognizable punk stage mode; other genre variants are not yet supplied.
